caption:
Below ten thousand dollars in which year?

Losing 20% a year isn't $6,000 a year. Each year's drop is 20% of a smaller number, so count year by year.

Comment your answer before you check.
tiktok_caption: A $30,000 car loses 20% a year. When is it worth less than $10,000?
